lessonTitle: 43. Place value and reading decimals — Practice
lessonTitleEnglish: Place value and reading decimals — Practice
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 6 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Which digit is in the tenths place of 41.92?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which digit is in the tenths place of 41.92?
stages.problemText: Which digit is in the tenths place of 41.92?

stages.headline: Write: zero and eight thousandths.
stages.customInstructions: Accept a decimal point or a decimal comma (0.5 or 0.5).

stages.headline: Write: seven and twenty hundredths.
stages.customInstructions: Accept a decimal point or a decimal comma (0.5 or 0.5). Accept 7.2 or 7.20.

stages.headline: How is 12.3 read?
stages.correctAnswer: twelve point three (twelve and three tenths)
